name: road-corner
prompt: Create one production 2D game road-texture sprite, in the exact hand-painted material style of the supplied straight road. OUTER curb follows a quarter circle of radius100% from (0%,100%) to(100%,0%); outer asphalt boundary radius92%. INNER curb is quarter circle radius8%-16% at lower-right. Thus at bottom: curb x0-8%, asphalt x8-92%, curb x92-100%; at right: curb y0-8%, asphalt y8-92%, curb y92-100%. The northwest outside the outer arc and small southeast inside the inner arc are fully transparent. No pavement, grass or baked checkerboard outside. Center dashes follow a rounded quarter circle of radius50% from (50%,100%) to(100%,50%), at most two short dashes, each same thin width as reference. Image is a WIDE fan-like smooth turn occupying most of canvas; no thin L-shape. No margin around entry edges.
